name: Willis Towers Watson
original_rationale: Global broker/consultant; verified 2-8% organic 2019-25 with no negative year; base growth cut to 4.5% (Q3-26 organic 4%, softening rates) gives base 5y IRR ~9.1% - AT the hurdle, so accumulate only at/below the 9%-IRR price. Chosen over Alcon (equal IRR) for portfolio fit: only non-healthcare, non-consumer factor in the basket. Risks: P&C rate cycle, fiduciary income, AI commission pressure, lower quality score.
measurable_expectations: Organic growth >=4% p.a. through softer P&C pricing
Adjusted operating margin rising year on year
Client retention stable; producer attrition low
FCF conversion >=100% of adjusted net income; buybacks below intrinsic value

scenarios_local.base_growth_source: GUIDANCE-ANCHORED OVERRIDE: Q3-2026 organic 4% with softening P&C rates and delayed large-client implementations (Q3 call 29-Oct-2026); verified 2019-25 organic 2-8% with no negative year; 4.5% = recent run-rate.

principal_risks: Lowest organic growth of the global three (4% Q3-26).
HWC exposed to benefits-admin automation and Middle East disruption; BD&O implementation delays.
Strategic stop-start (Willis Re sold 2021, re-entered 2026) raises execution risk.
thesis_break_conditions: Organic growth < 3% for a full year.
Adjusted operating margin fails to expand in 2027.
